comdynamite: Linking Traits, Phylogenies and Biogeography in Metacommunities

Source: R/comdynamite-package.R
comdynamite-package.Rd

Methods that link traits, phylogenies, biogeography and metacommunities, to analyse data and to simulate it. Analyses include the node regression of Leibold et al. (2010) doi:10.1111/j.1461-0248.2010.01523.x , with biogeographic events and restricted null models, the phylogenetic gradient analysis of Peres-Neto et al. (2012) doi:10.1890/11-0494.1 , and the phylogenetic community composition and beta diversity tests of Peres-Neto and Kembel (2015) doi:10.1007/s11258-014-0405-0 . Simulations follow the process-based model of Thompson et al. (2020) doi:10.1111/ele.13568 , with environmental filtering, competition, demographic stochasticity and dispersal in spatially implicit or grid landscapes. Species traits can carry phylogenetic signal or evolve under an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process, and competition can be structured by relatedness. Rule-based assembly follows Kraft et al. (2007) doi:10.1086/519400 . Models were implemented from the published equations.

Analyse data

  • Which clades respond to the environment or to biogeographic events? node_contrasts() codes the nodes, biogeography_matrix() the events and node_test() tests them. plot_node_test() and plot_node_heatmap() show the results.

  • Does phylogenetic composition follow the environment across the whole tree? pcc_test() and pcps_test() work on phylogenetic eigenvectors and phylo_beta_test() on the phylogenetic distances between communities, from phylo_beta(), shown by plot_phylo_beta().

  • Which phylogenetic axis relates to a predictor? phylo_vector().

  • How much of trait or phylogenetic variation is due to environment and space? trait_partition() and plot_trait_partition().

  • Are sites neighbours? torus_permutations() gives restricted null models for a torus, and rigid_permutations() and patch_permutations() for the events of a landscape with edges.

Simulate data

  • Dynamics with growth, competition and dispersal: simulate_metacommunity(), from landscape_implicit() or landscape_grid(), species_traits() and competition_matrix().

  • Static communities along gradients: simulate_static() and simulate_logistic().

  • Assembly by rules, without dynamics: assemble_community().

  • Traits on a tree: species_traits(), trait_bm() and trait_ou(), with correlated traits from rate_matrix().

Where to start

The articles at https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/articles/ go through each question. "Preparing your data" shows the format that the analyses expect.
